title: How to organize the floor and circulation path | Living Room
description:
Let anyone cross this room in the dark, carrying something, without touching anything.

This is the Floor and Circulation Path in the Living Room. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
A continuous clear route from the doorway past the sofa to the other exit, wide enough for two people to pass and for the vacuum to run through without being lifted. Rug edges lying flat on a grippy pad, no cord crossing the route, and nothing on the floor but furniture legs, the rug, and baskets pushed back against the wall.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Walk the route with a laundry basket and put every floor item in it: shoes, toys, yesterday's bag, the pile of
Straighten: Floor baskets go against a wall or under the side table, never in the route, and each one gets a named categor
Shine: Vacuum the route, then move the sofa and chair legs and do underneath, because that is where pet hair and dust
Safety: Curled rug corners, the lamp cord crossing the route and toys left in the dark are the three falls this room p
Standardize: Full width, always, and you check it by walking the route with a full basket in both hands rather than by stan
Sustain: When the vacuum comes out, anything still on the floor when you finish goes into the basket and gets returned

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
The route from door to door stays clear at its full width.
